1<?php
2/**
3 * php-parser visitor which, in a single traversal, records the location of every symbol definition, symbol usage,
4 * comment, string and inline HTML region in a file.
5 *
6 * Run after {@see \PhpParser\NodeVisitor\NameResolver} (with `replaceNodes` disabled) so `resolvedName` attributes
7 * are available.
8 */
9
10declare(strict_types=1);
11
12namespace BrianHenryIE\Strauss\Pipeline\FileSymbol;
13
14use BrianHenryIE\Strauss\Files\CodeLocation;
15use PhpParser\Node;
16use PhpParser\Node\Expr\ConstFetch;
17use PhpParser\Node\Expr\FuncCall;
18use PhpParser\Node\Expr\ShellExec;

20use PhpParser\Node\Name\FullyQualified;
21use PhpParser\Node\Scalar\InterpolatedString;
22use PhpParser\Node\Scalar\String_;
23use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Class_;
24use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Const_;
25use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Enum_;
26use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Function_;
27use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\GroupUse;
28use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\InlineHTML;
29use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Interface_;
30use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Namespace_;
31use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Trait_;
32use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Use_;

37class FileCodeMapVisitor extends NodeVisitorAbstract
38{
39    /**
40     * PHP functions whose first argument is a string naming a function.
41     */
42    public const FUNCTIONS_USING_CALLABLE = [
43        'function_exists' => true,
44        'call_user_func' => true,
45        'call_user_func_array' => true,
46        'forward_static_call' => true,
47        'forward_static_call_array' => true,
48        'register_shutdown_function' => true,
49        'register_tick_function' => true,
50        'unregister_tick_function' => true,
51    ];
52
53    /**
54     * PHP functions whose first argument is a string naming a constant.
55     */
56    public const FUNCTIONS_USING_CONSTANT_NAME = [
57        'define' => true,
58        'defined' => true,
59    ];
60
61    protected string $contents;
62
63    /** @var CodeLocation[] */
64    protected array $locations = [];
65
66    /** @var SymbolDefinition[] In declaration order. */
67    protected array $definitions = [];
68
69    /** @var array<string,bool> Namespace names in declaration order (`\` for global). */
70    protected array $namespaceNames = [];
71
72    /** @var ?string Current namespace, null when global. */
73    protected ?string $currentNamespace = null;
74
75    /** @var array<int,bool> spl_object_id of Name nodes already recorded with a specific role. */
76    protected array $claimedNames = [];
77
78    /**
79     * Every comment token in the file, ascending by position. Taken from the tokens rather than from the nodes'
80     * attached comments, which omit comments not followed by a node (e.g. after the last argument or array item).
81     *
82     * @var Token[]
83     */
84    protected array $commentTokens = [];
85
86    /** Index in {@see self::$commentTokens} of the next comment to record. */
87    protected int $nextCommentToken = 0;
88
89    /**
90     * @param Token[] $tokens The tokens of the contents: {@see \PhpParser\Parser::getTokens()}.
91     */
92    public function __construct(string $contents, array $tokens = [])
93    {
94        $this->contents = $contents;
95        $this->commentTokens = array_values(array_filter(
96            $tokens,
97            fn(Token $token): bool => $token->is([T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT])
98        ));
99    }
100
101    /**
102     * @return CodeLocation[]
103     */
104    public function getLocations(): array
105    {
106        return $this->locations;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * @return SymbolDefinition[]
111     */
112    public function getDefinitions(): array
113    {
114        return $this->definitions;
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * @return string[]
119     */
120    public function getNamespaceNames(): array
121    {
122        return array_keys($this->namespaceNames);
123    }

125    public function enterNode(Node $node)
126    {
127        // Before a namespace node changes the current namespace, so each comment is recorded in the namespace it
128        // is written in.
129        $this->addCommentLocationsBefore($node->getStartFilePos());
130
131        if ($node instanceof Namespace_) {
132            $this->enterNamespace($node);
133            return null;
134        }
135
136        if ($node instanceof Use_) {
137            foreach ($node->uses as $item) {
138                $this->addUseItemLocation($item, $node->type, false);
139            }
140            return null;
141        }
142
143        if ($node instanceof GroupUse) {
144            $this->claimName($node->prefix);
145            $location = $this->addNameLocation(CodeLocation::GROUP_USE_PREFIX, $node->prefix);
146            $location->setUseType($node->type);
147            foreach ($node->uses as $item) {
148                $this->addUseItemLocation($item, $node->type, true);
149            }
150            return null;
151        }
152
153        if ($node instanceof ConstFetch) {
154            $this->claimName($node->name);
155            $this->addNameLocation(CodeLocation::CONST_FETCH, $node->name);
156            return null;
157        }
158
159        if ($node instanceof FuncCall) {
160            $this->enterFuncCall($node);
161            return null;
162        }
163
164        if ($node instanceof Class_ || $node instanceof Interface_ || $node instanceof Trait_ || $node instanceof Enum_) {
165            $this->enterClassLike($node);
166            return null;
167        }
168
169        if ($node instanceof Function_) {
170            $this->enterFunction($node);
171            return null;
172        }
173
174        if ($node instanceof Const_) {
175            $this->enterConst($node);
176            return null;
177        }
178
179        if ($node instanceof Name) {
180            if (!isset($this->claimedNames[spl_object_id($node)])) {
181                $this->addNameLocation(CodeLocation::NAME, $node);
182            }
183            return null;
184        }
185
186        if ($node instanceof String_ || $node instanceof InterpolatedString || $node instanceof ShellExec) {
187            $this->locations[] = new CodeLocation(
188                CodeLocation::STRING,
189                $node->getStartFilePos(),
190                $this->getNodeText($node),
191                $this->currentNamespace
192            );
193            return null;
194        }
195
196        if ($node instanceof InlineHTML) {
197            $this->locations[] = new CodeLocation(
198                CodeLocation::INLINE_HTML,
199                $node->getStartFilePos(),
200                $this->getNodeText($node),
201                $this->currentNamespace
202            );
203            return null;
204        }
205
206        return null;
207    }
208
209    /**
210     * Comments after the last node.
211     */
212    public function afterTraverse(array $nodes)
213    {
214        $this->addCommentLocationsBefore(PHP_INT_MAX);
215        return null;
216    }
217
218    protected function addCommentLocationsBefore(int $position): void
219    {
220        while (isset($this->commentTokens[$this->nextCommentToken])
221            && $this->commentTokens[$this->nextCommentToken]->pos < $position
222        ) {
223            $token = $this->commentTokens[$this->nextCommentToken++];
224            $this->locations[] = new CodeLocation(
225                $token->is(T_DOC_COMMENT) ? CodeLocation::DOC_COMMENT : CodeLocation::COMMENT,
226                $token->pos,
227                $token->text,
228                $this->currentNamespace
229            );
230        }
231    }
232
233    protected function enterNamespace(Namespace_ $node): void
234    {
235        $this->currentNamespace = $node->name ? $node->name->toString() : null;
236        $namespaceName = $this->currentNamespace ?? '\\';
237
238        $location = null;
239        if ($node->name) {
240            $this->claimName($node->name);
241            $location = $this->addNameLocation(CodeLocation::NAMESPACE_DEFINITION, $node->name);
242        }
243
244        if (!isset($this->namespaceNames[$namespaceName])) {
245            $this->namespaceNames[$namespaceName] = true;
246            $this->definitions[] = new SymbolDefinition(
247                SymbolDefinition::TYPE_NAMESPACE,
248                $namespaceName,
249                $namespaceName,
250                $location
251            );
252        }
253    }
254
255    protected function enterFuncCall(FuncCall $node): void
256    {
257        if (!($node->name instanceof Name)) {
258            // E.g. a variable or expression being called.
259            return;
260        }
261
262        $this->claimName($node->name);
263        $this->addNameLocation(CodeLocation::FUNCTION_CALL, $node->name);
264
265        $functionName = strtolower($node->name->toString());
266
267        $firstArg = $node->args[0] ?? null;
268        if (!($firstArg instanceof Node\Arg) || !($firstArg->value instanceof String_)) {
269            return;
270        }
271        $stringNode = $firstArg->value;
272
273        if (isset(self::FUNCTIONS_USING_CALLABLE[$functionName])) {
274            $this->addStringArgLocation(CodeLocation::CALLABLE_STRING_ARG, $stringNode);
275        }
276
277        if (isset(self::FUNCTIONS_USING_CONSTANT_NAME[$functionName])) {
278            $location = $this->addStringArgLocation(CodeLocation::DEFINE_STRING_ARG, $stringNode);
279
280            if ('define' === $functionName && '' !== trim($stringNode->value, '\\')) {
281                // NB: `define()` always defines a global constant, but Strauss has always recorded it under the
282                // current namespace, e.g. `My\Namespace\MY_CONSTANT`.
283                $this->definitions[] = new SymbolDefinition(
284                    SymbolDefinition::TYPE_CONSTANT,
285                    $stringNode->value,
286                    $this->currentNamespace ?? '\\',
287                    $location
288                );
289            }
290        }
291    }
292
293    /**
294     * @param Class_|Interface_|Trait_|Enum_ $node
295     */
296    protected function enterClassLike(Node $node): void
297    {
298        if (is_null($node->name)) {
299            // Anonymous class.
300            return;
301        }
302
303        $nameLocation = new CodeLocation(
304            $this->getDefinitionLocationType($node),
305            $node->name->getStartFilePos(),
306            $node->name->name,
307            $this->currentNamespace
308        );
309        $this->locations[] = $nameLocation;
310
311        $definition = new SymbolDefinition(
312            $this->getDefinitionSymbolType($node),
313            $this->qualify($node->name->name),
314            $this->currentNamespace ?? '\\',
315            $nameLocation
316        );
317
318        if ($node instanceof Class_) {
319            $definition->setIsAbstract($node->isAbstract());
320            if ($node->extends) {
321                $definition->setExtends($this->resolveName($node->extends));
322            }
323            $definition->setInterfaces(array_map([$this, 'resolveName'], $node->implements));
324        } elseif ($node instanceof Interface_) {
325            // For interfaces, the "interfaces" are the parent interfaces it extends.
326            $definition->setInterfaces(array_map([$this, 'resolveName'], $node->extends));
327        } elseif ($node instanceof Enum_) {
328            $definition->setBackingType($node->scalarType instanceof Node\Identifier ? $node->scalarType->name : null);
329            $definition->setInterfaces(array_map([$this, 'resolveName'], $node->implements));
330        }
331
332        $this->definitions[] = $definition;
333    }
334
335    protected function enterFunction(Function_ $node): void
336    {
337        $nameLocation = new CodeLocation(
338            CodeLocation::FUNCTION_DEFINITION,
339            $node->name->getStartFilePos(),
340            $node->name->name,
341            $this->currentNamespace
342        );
343        $this->locations[] = $nameLocation;
344
345        $this->definitions[] = new SymbolDefinition(
346            SymbolDefinition::TYPE_FUNCTION,
347            $this->qualify($node->name->name),
348            $this->currentNamespace ?? '\\',
349            $nameLocation
350        );
351    }
352
353    /**
354     * `const NAME = ...;` (class constants are `ClassConst`, not `Const_`).
355     */
356    protected function enterConst(Const_ $node): void
357    {
358        foreach ($node->consts as $const) {
359            $nameLocation = new CodeLocation(
360                CodeLocation::CONST_DEFINITION,
361                $const->name->getStartFilePos(),
362                $const->name->name,
363                $this->currentNamespace
364            );
365            $this->locations[] = $nameLocation;
366
367            $this->definitions[] = new SymbolDefinition(
368                SymbolDefinition::TYPE_CONSTANT,
369                $const->name->name,
370                $this->currentNamespace ?? '\\',
371                $nameLocation
372            );
373        }
374    }
375
376    protected function addUseItemLocation(UseItem $item, int $stmtUseType, bool $inGroupUse): void
377    {
378        $this->claimName($item->name);
379        $location = $this->addNameLocation(CodeLocation::USE_NAME, $item->name);
380        // The item's own type wins over the statement's, e.g. `use Prefix\{function foo}`.
381        $location->setUseType(Use_::TYPE_UNKNOWN !== $item->type ? $item->type : $stmtUseType);
382        $location->setInGroupUse($inGroupUse);
383        $location->setHasAlias(!is_null($item->alias));
384        if (!$inGroupUse) {
385            // An import is already fully qualified.
386            $location->setResolvedName($item->name->toString());
387        }
388    }
389
390    protected function addNameLocation(string $type, Name $name): CodeLocation
391    {
392        $location = new CodeLocation(
393            $type,
394            $name->getStartFilePos(),
395            $this->getNodeText($name),
396            $this->currentNamespace
397        );
398        $location->setMatchName($name->toString());
399        // NB: from the node type, not the text: `use \Bar\Baz;` is written with a leading `\` but parses as a
400        // plain Name.
401        $location->setIsFullyQualifiedName($name instanceof FullyQualified);
402
403        $resolvedName = $name->getAttribute('resolvedName');
404        if ($resolvedName instanceof Name) {
405            $location->setResolvedName($resolvedName->toString());
406        } elseif ($name instanceof FullyQualified) {
407            $location->setResolvedName($name->toString());
408        }
409
410        $this->locations[] = $location;
411
412        return $location;
413    }
414
415    protected function addStringArgLocation(string $type, String_ $stringNode): CodeLocation
416    {
417        // Exclude the quotes so a replacement cannot change them.
418        $start = $stringNode->getStartFilePos() + 1;
419        $length = $stringNode->getEndFilePos() - $stringNode->getStartFilePos() - 1;
420        $location = new CodeLocation(
421            $type,
422            $start,
423            substr($this->contents, $start, $length),
424            $this->currentNamespace,
425            $length
426        );
427        // The unescaped string value, for matching against symbol names.
428        $location->setMatchName($stringNode->value);
429        $this->locations[] = $location;
430
431        return $location;
432    }
433
434    protected function claimName(Name $name): void
435    {
436        $this->claimedNames[spl_object_id($name)] = true;
437    }
438
439    protected function getNodeText(Node $node): string
440    {
441        return substr(
442            $this->contents,
443            $node->getStartFilePos(),
444            $node->getEndFilePos() - $node->getStartFilePos() + 1
445        );
446    }
447
448    protected function qualify(string $localName): string
449    {
450        return is_null($this->currentNamespace)
451            ? $localName
452            : $this->currentNamespace . '\\' . $localName;
453    }
454
455    /**
456     * The fully qualified name, without leading `\`, of a class name in `extends` or `implements`.
457     */
458    protected function resolveName(Name $name): string
459    {
460        $resolvedName = $name->getAttribute('resolvedName');
461
462        return $resolvedName instanceof Name
463            ? $resolvedName->toString()
464            : $name->toString();
465    }
466
467    /**
468     * @param Class_|Interface_|Trait_|Enum_ $node
469     */
470    protected function getDefinitionLocationType(Node $node): string
471    {
472        switch (true) {
473            case $node instanceof Class_:
474                return CodeLocation::CLASS_DEFINITION;
475            case $node instanceof Interface_:
476                return CodeLocation::INTERFACE_DEFINITION;
477            case $node instanceof Trait_:
478                return CodeLocation::TRAIT_DEFINITION;
479            default:
480                return CodeLocation::ENUM_DEFINITION;
